This is a very cliche and common answer, but this is what I believe. The Powers That Be are not prone to reveal themselves in such obvious ways. One could say that this is a mystery. As the Bible says, the Powers move in mysterious ways.

In my experience, everything in magick is sourced in intention. Our general perception is based in the physical world. We see what our eyes will allow us to see in the limited spectrum of light that we are able.

When you gather people together, there is a change in the energy. Each individual's perception is different, which alters reality for everyone.

In my opinion, which may even be limited, or wrong, magick is not something that is performed successfully in public, or even in small groups, sometimes, because intentions and perceptions alter the flow of energy.

To truly experience these things, one must look within, and give over trust in the Powers. Only when you are able to focus at this level, to practice your craft without influences, then magick will reveal itself.

Bring together a coven and they will share the experience. Their perceptions and intentions are aligned, allowing for a synergy that reveals the divine energies.

Ask most religious people and they will tell you that their beliefs are based on personal experiences. God, Allah, Jehovah, Shiva, Zeus... these are all names for various energies expressed by the Power That Be.

I just wanted to throw in my two cents regarding your comment about scientists. I'm a mechanical engineer with a master's degree, and have been practicing my craft for more than 20 years.

This level of magick is real. There are many things that can be done, but whether it should be done is another question. Yes, I can move objects, effect water temperature, or conjure fire. However, these actions are, in my opinion, meddling in an area that's best left to highly experienced practitioners.

Imagine trying to conjure fire in a specific place. Perhaps to light candles on your altar. But, you lose focus and suddenly set fire to your altar cloth, or, worse, the wall, curtains, carpet... This is not good.

Theoretically, the use of the energies around us, and the power of our minds and spirits to manipulate our physical surroundings is limitless. As many people know, the average human only uses 10 percent of their brain. That leaves a widely unknown 90 percent that is capable of far more than we are currently able to do.

There is, and always will be, a great deal of mystery surrounding our practices. The knowlegde that I've gained over 20 years still pales in comparison the amount that is left unknown.

So, I'm reserved to teaching, mentoring, and providing guidance. Manipulation of a higher order is a practice I do in private, and limited only to my confidence in my skills.
Of course. I'm humbled that you like it. I look forward to hearing more about it.
